<DESCRIPTION>RELEASE AND SETTLEMENT WITH CAPIZZANO, DECEMBER 8, 2010

     <TITLE></TITLE>

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.33</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>RELEASE AND SETTLEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">Dated this 8<SUP>th</SUP> day of December 2010, by and between Viral
Genetics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&quot;Viral&quot;) and Michael Capizzano (&quot;Capizzano&quot;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS under an Assignment Agreement between
Capizzano and Wolf, Greenfield &amp; Sacks, P.C., dated December 8, 2010 attached hereto (the &quot;Assignment&quot;), Capizzano
is the holder and owner of lawfully assigned debts in the amount of fifty-three thousand seven hundred and fourteen dollars and
twenty-three cents ($53,714.23), inclusive of all interest accrued thereon as of the date affixed hereof, (the &quot;Debt&quot;),
and is desirous of settling the Debt with Viral, and Viral is desirous of same.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">NOW THEREFORE for good and lawful consideration, the receipt and
sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">1.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Capizzano hereby represents and warrants that he has full right, title and ownership to the Debt
pursuant to the Assignment.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">2.</TD><TD>Capizzano hereby irrevocably tenders and assigns to Viral full right, ownership and title to the Debt in exchange for 5,371,423
shares of common stock of Viral, and has provided the Notice of Conversion attached hereto as Exhibit A.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">3.</TD><TD>Capizzano hereby provides a complete and irrevocable release of any and all liabilities, fees, penalties, interests or claims
of any kind in regard to the Debt and acknowledges that same has been satisfied in full.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">4.</TD><TD>This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">Agreed as of the date affixed hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>NOTICE OF CONVERSION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

shares of common stock, par value $0.0001 per share of the Company (the <U>&quot;Common Stock</U>&quot;), according to the conditions
hereof, as of the date written below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The undersigned agrees to comply with applicable
securities laws in connection with any transfer of the aforesaid shares of Common Stock.</P>
